SYMPTOM: Maestro tapOn(label) finds keyboard buttons (COMPLETED) but UIControl actions never fire — no text inserted, no page switch.
CAUSE: iOS keyboard extension process isolation prevents accessibility-based tap events from firing UIControl targets.
FIX: Use tapOn with percentage coordinates (e.g., 42%,59%) — these physically simulate touch events and DO trigger button actions.
GOTCHA: Coordinates are finicky. The system adds a bottom bar (home indicator + globe) below the extension frame, so row 4 coordinates are higher than estimated (~74-78% not 82-84%). Simulator reboot required when keyboard rotation gets stuck. `inputText` goes through textDocumentProxy and is the most reliable way to verify text insertion works.
